Thousand Hills Cargo Services Ltd

Thousand Hills Cargo Services Ltd is a cargo general sales and service agent (GSSA) based at Kigali International Airport (KGL), part of Umubano Logistics Group. (Invented company: test fixture.)

We provide cargo sales, reservations and customer service for the airlines we represent, with offices in Kigali, Rwanda and Nairobi, Kenya.
